title: Bound EUR context event initializer callsites
changes: Record a bounded static census of aligned Thumb calls to the context event initializer.
validation: Wine read-only scan of the exact EUR ROM found one aligned Thumb BL candidate to 0814352c, call 08140b44, already connected to the E139 event source: e140-event-calls-wine-ur8ojq9h.
limitations: The encoding scan does not prove reachability or exclude indirect callers, alternate instruction modes, other images or unrelated source tables. No performance measurements.
